author: Veli Raiya
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. For now needs portraits, with more work if the style fits the series. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Hiring illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draw anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up: still reviewing portfolios and asking people who have not sent a portfolio to share a link. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.

author: Bee (Shel)
title: Commissioning character and concept art for fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I'm a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I'm looking for artists to help bring it to life! I'm starting small, but this is paid work. I'm looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Follow-up: still early, figuring out funding and budgeting, and planning more posts about the show; request not marked closed. Contact: comment with work and rates or DM @bee.chaoticcore.
